[[Crypt Wraith]]s are [[undead]] [[mesmer]]s found in some [[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]] [[dungeon]]s. They carry several [[interrupt]] spells that can [[shutdown]] a [[party]]'s [[spellcaster]]s.
